reviews.text: Super good wash, blowdry and cut for my sweet mini pom. 👏🏽 very happy! 😁

I heard that Jose and Isadora work there now. I can tell you they did Max incredibly well and they are highly recommended. Unfortunately, Zeeburg is too far for me. They treated Max with a lot of love and are missed.
Thank you so much. See you soon  :)
Always great here! Mostly recently with new groomer José - thank you :)
I loved this work by Isadora.

We had such a wonderful experience with Jose and Isadora! They were incredibly kind, professional and caring, and you can really see how much they love what they do. We felt completely comfortable leaving our dogs in their hands, and the result was amazing  they looked absolutely beautiful! 😍

Thank you so much, Jose and Isadora, for taking such great care of them. We’re very happy with the experience and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for caring and talented groomers. ❤️
Hey Edgardo. Thank you so much for your feedback! See you soon  :)

Since we got 4 years ago our beloved Scotty we always come to this trimsalon. Nuria has always been taking good care of our Golden Retriever and she does an amazing job. Even though Scotty can sometimes be a bit stubborn, as a good Golden, she never loses her patience and does a great job. We get every time a well-trimmed, clean dog. We’ll keep on trusting on Reino Canino for our Scotty. Thank you very much, Nuria!
Nuria made sure that it was a pleasant experience for my senior dog Proxy. I really felt happy with how Proxy was taken care of. Thank you 🙏 …
Very professional, love this place!

This place has the nicest people. The owner always make sure my dog, who is overly excited, is taken care of. My dog Tami is always excited to go back and i can see with his fur and paws they are treated with uttermost care.

Very good groomers. They will groom your dog the way you want it. The whole package for a reasonable price. I reccomend this salon very much. I can't wait to get my dog there again. And very professional and friendly service.
nice and accomodating staffs

I've known the salon since it opened. My dog ​​went there to get groomed. The people who work there aren't professionals, and I'm talking about a few years ago. I lived around the corner. My son walked back and forth past the salon a few times and saw that the dogs weren't treated kindly. My son told me, "Our dog is never going there again." She also had injuries to her paws. Not one of them was certified to groom back then.

The woman who works there (black hair, tattoos on her arms) was violently attacking the dog, pulling him wildly while blow-drying him, probably too hot for the dog, and clearly not in the mood. I felt really sorry for the dog. I could see everything from outside.
Super proffesioal, crafted and kind people who work there. My dog came out as a supermodel.
I am always 100% satisfied when I see my dog after her fur treatment: she looks beautyful. The staf is frendly and very professional.

Update Nov 2025
Unfortunately their good wire fox/welshie hand stripper is no longer able to travel up to AMS to groom. No fault of theirs, but the replacement groomer is not up to par for these hard to groom breeds.

——
Easy to book, and very helpful when a rebooking was needed to get the right dog/groomer combo.
Did a solid job hand stripping a fox terrier. Will be back.
They do not keep their appointment and cancel at the last minute. They hurt my dog ​​and I am never happy with the end result. The service is not friendly either.

Very antisocial, not keeping their appointments and it's a mess, so based on experience, I would NEVER EVER take my pet there again. No trustworthiness, they make bad appointments and the atmosphere is very, very bad. You are a warning. NEVER MORE bring my pet to them 👎🏾👎🏾👎🏾 …
Received very nice and friendly service, my Pomeranian Ice Baby is completely happy 🥰 …

What a terrible experience. We brought our dog here for the second time. But really, never again!!!

Upon arriving home, it turned out he was badly injured. They had clearly cut his paw with the clippers. Our dog must have screamed. But they didn't tell us when we picked him up. He was also really badly cut. Tufts of fur everywhere. Also, deep grooves from the clippers. Clearly, they have absolutely no skill in how to treat a dog. Our Labradoodle is severely traumatized, suddenly shy, and barking at everything and everyone. A real disaster.

We sent an email and got our money back. Their story was that he had too many tangles and that they were very sorry.
However, he didn't have tangles. They clearly can't cut hair properly, and something happened there that cannot be undone. Their apology is also out of the question, because it has been five days now, and if you are an animal lover, you would call after a few days to ask how the dog is doing. We are almost a week down the line and haven't heard anything.

In summary: our dog is injured, traumatized, and truly groomed too badly for words.

I am now reading about several incidents of this kind here regarding this groomer. Their responses are consistently unprofessional. So please do not let any potential response from the groomer to this review sway you.

Always a pleasure! Well done and thanks on behalf of both Ox (dog) and myself! Cheers
We went for a little Mohawk this time 😂 …
Hello Johannes. We appreciate so much. Thank you. See you soon  :)
Valeryia did an amazing job! She is very gentle with the dogs and always gives me exactly what I asked for!
Very friendly and professional team, very happy with the service to my dog.

I have a Labradoodle quite big, 15kg but he is only 5 months old. I booked a "Puppy Training" session because he never been to a grooming saloon. One day before they called me asking more information about the pet, I told them "it's a labradoodle, 15 kilos but it's only 5 months, his fur is big but not matted, would this work?" They told me "yes but because it's a puppy training we won't do a full grooming". I said ok, no problem.

It's 1h away from home, when we arrived the lady instantly told me she won't be able to do anything with him. And I would need to book for another day.

I left this review here (1 star) and they replied:

"Dear Herlon and your huge Golden Doodle Ollie. You made a reservation for a Puppy training. We called you yesterday and you lied to us about the size, age & the fur contitions."

Well, not sure where I lied here I even had his passport with me to show that he is not old. I already told them the he is big and 15 kilos and the fur is also long but not matted.

I don't know if they don't understand English well or what, so just be aware that you might be the next one they call "LIAR".

Took my rescue dog Cookie here for his first wash. Their flyer says €30–50 for small dogs, but over the phone I was told €50–60—which I didn’t realize was already above the advertised price.

Then, half an hour before the appointment, they called to say I had to come 20–30 minutes late, or they'd put him in a cage. Since it was his first grooming and he’s from a shelter, I didn’t want him crated unnecessarily, so I came late as asked.

When I arrived, they were running behind. One person was grooming, another dog was waiting, and I don’t know when they actually started with Cookie. When I came back two hours later, they brought him out from the back—which made me think he’d been caged anyway. He looked really scared.

They charged me €70: €50 for the wash, €10 for a “white treatment” I didn’t ask for, and €10 for detangling—none of which were discussed beforehand. On top of that, the cut around his rear looked terrible, like he had an accident.

Overall, it felt disorganized, overpriced, and not the gentle experience I hoped for—especially for a rescue’s first grooming.

Update:
After the appointment, I discovered a significant cut on Cookie’s tail that definitely wasn’t there before. It clearly happened during grooming, which is deeply upsetting.

I strongly recommend avoiding this grooming salon. The experience left both me and my dog stressed and disappointed.
Dear Hugo. Thank you very much for taking your time and giving us a good review. We are very happy that you liked our services. We hope to see you again very soon. Best regards

This was the second time here, the first time we had a lady that did the poodle cut. This time was a guy, the dog didn’t even looked brushed, completely out of proportion, he did everything in the same length. His ears still full of hair, i am very disappointed at this place. You really expect a certain level of attention when you pay 90e for a cut. Never coming here again.
Dear Avdhesh. We are very grateful for the hassle and the stars of the good service we have offered you, we hope to see you very soon. Thanks a lot.

What irresponsible and amateurish people you are! After three years of receiving positive feedback about my sweet husky's behavior with you, I've now changed my appointment twice because you claim your groomer thinks my dog ​​always has behavioral problems with you. So you've been lying for three years to make money? Unbelievable!
You must never come near my dog ​​again!
By the way, please let your employees know they should always speak to customers with respect, not like they're our bosses!
Valeryia is the best!

It was Zuko’s first grooming session and Nuria took great care of him. The staff were so sweet and caring! The grooming session was for 2 hours and they did such a great job with cutting and cleaning and patiently so!
Thank you guys!
Always caring and very professional <3

I brought both of my dogs here for the first time in the Netherlands, never brought them before in the Netherlands because I was too scared, because I didn’t know how they will be teated. But this wonderful groomer Irina did an amazing job. The dogs left happy with new beautiful haircuts. Definitely will be bringing them again to Irina!

I had a truly terrible experience with this dog groomer. Our dog was traumatized by their treatment; ever since, she's been scared and anxious around anyone who touches her, even her regular vet, whom she normally has no problem with. This speaks volumes about how they treat animals there.

To make matters worse, they ridiculed my mother by claiming we didn't take good care of our dog. They even said our dog was no longer welcome because of her "behavior." My regular groomer always praises her as a sweetheart, so this was not only insulting but also completely unfounded.

As if that wasn't enough, they also gave our dog a terrible haircut. It's clear they have no heart or patience for working with dogs. Every dog ​​is different, and you need to treat them professionally. Unfortunately, that proved to be lacking here. The fact that we had to pay €120 for this makes it absolutely outrageous.

My advice: go somewhere else, find a dog groomer who works with love and patience. This case should be ashamed and maybe consider finding another profession.
Very good
Amazing Experience! Have no words to describe how professional they staff is! Absolutely recommend! The location is also very good!
